meta.title: Plumb, tungsten darts · design demo
meta.description: Plumb is a fictional tungsten dart, told as an immersive 3D product page: a design and engineering demo built to keep Lighthouse at 100 and to meet WCAG 2.2 AA.

hero.lede: Plumb darts are front-loaded tungsten, cut for a grip you stop noticing. The name comes from the plumbata, the lead-weighted throwing dart of Roman soldiers.

grip.title: Grip you stop noticing.
grip.body: Eighteen rings, each 0.3 mm deep and 1.2 mm apart. Your fingers find the same place, throw after throw, without looking for it.

weight.title: Weight where it counts.
weight.body: Sixty per cent of the mass sits ahead of your fingers. The dart wants to fly point first, so you stop steering it.

anatomy.title: Four parts, one line.
anatomy.body: Every part is turned on the same axis, so the dart leaves your hand the way you aimed it.

throw.title: Finish the leg.
throw.body: Forty left. Hit double 20, tops, to win the leg. You have three darts.
throw.pointerHint: Tap or click the board to throw where you point, or pick a target below.
throw.noDarts: No darts left. Collect them to throw again.

checkout.title: Game shot.
checkout.body: Plumb doesn't exist. This page shows how an immersive product story can still load fast and work for everyone: with a keyboard, a screen reader, reduced motion, or no 3D at all.

footer.disclaimer: Plumb is a fictional brand made for a design and engineering demo. Nothing is for sale.

notFound.title: Missed the board.
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist. Even the best players miss sometimes.
